headline_summary: 霍尔木兹油轮再起火叠加美众议院阻击俄油协议推动WTI破101美元、内盘燃油夜盘涨超4%；美股AI债务担忧令费半周挫11.8%、VIX飙至19.99，而做多TSM/MSFT空SOXX配对逆势斩获正Alpha。

key_divergences: WTI Nov crude surged +3.51% to settle at $101.41/bbl (late electronic $101.84) and Brent Dec jumped +3.72% to $109.86/bbl as a second tanker caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, Eurasia Group raised Gulf escalation odds to 65%, and bipartisan US House members moved to block the Russian diesel deal.

US tech/semiconductor selloff deepened on Friday Oct 16 OPEX (Nasdaq -2.15%, QQQ -2.50%, SOXX -4.14% 1D / -11.80% 5D, VIX +21.45% to 19.99), yet our Top 1 Beta-neutral pair (Long 50% TSM + 50% MSFT / Short 100% SOXX) delivered +1.78% single-day positive Alpha as TSM/SOXX rose to 0.8363.

CXMT (688825.SH) pre-announced 9M26 net profit of 131.0B-132.5B RMB (Q3 revenue +15%-20% QoQ, Q3 net profit +1%-3% QoQ) and a 1.0B-2.0B RMB buyback on Oct 16 evening, confirming China IDM DRAM market share gains (7.67%) while downstream module maker Longsys (301308.SZ) fell another -0.96%.

China 10Y CGB yield broke below 1.65% (1.6385%) and 30Y CGB hit 2.055% despite regulatory risk management reminders to banks/brokers, while CSI 300 ETF (510300) volume jumped +141.5% to 16.09B RMB and Tongkun Group (601233.SH) closed up +5.41% at 20.26 RMB.
